name: dot-pattern

frames.best_why: The dot field reads evenly across the whole stage with several dots glowing brighter.

tagline: Tiny white dots twinkle across a dark, edge-faded field.
summary: A dotted backdrop for dark sections where each dot slowly breathes brighter and fades again on its own timing, and the whole field dissolves into black at the edges.
appearance: A near-black stage covered in a regular field of tiny white dots that thins to black toward the edges. A large white heading and two centred grey lines of copy sit over the dots.
behaviour: Individual dots slowly swell and brighten before shrinking back, each on its own random delay and duration, so the field twinkles instead of beating in unison.
demo_content: The centred heading reads "Dot Pattern" above a two-line description of the background.
use_when: A dark hero or panel wants gentle texture and depth behind its text.
avoid_when: Behind small body text: the dots compete with thin glyphs and hurt reading.
customise: Spacing, offsets and dot radius are props; toggle the glow with a flag and set the dot colour through a text class.
weight_why: Roughly a thousand SVG circles, each animated by the motion library at once.

a11y.note: The SVG is marked aria-hidden and carries no content; the endless twinkle ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Even, well-masked dot field with a believable twinkle; the small caption is faint.
